استئلت (form X)
# اُسْتُئِلْتُ (ustuʔiltu) /us.tu.ʔil.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِسْتَآلَ (istaʔāla)
# اُسْتُئِلْتَ (ustuʔilta) /us.tu.ʔil.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِسْتَآلَ (istaʔāla)
# اُسْتُئِلْتِ (ustuʔilti) /us.tu.ʔil.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِسْتَآلَ (istaʔāla)
